description: Use this when the user wants a reminder or a calendar entry for a session at a time of day: tonight at 9:30, every evening. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

day.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD, today or tomorrow. Default the next time it is that time.

mail.description: Also send one reminder mail. Only works with a linked 2hives account.

tap.description: The token from keep_progress for this conversation; leave empty if there is none.

timezone.description: The user's IANA time zone, if known. Default UTC.

name: schedule_session
title: Plan a session
